name: door-os-fullstack
description: Door OS - Full-Stack Browser Desktop Operating System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix door-os-backend" "npm run dev --prefix door-os-frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix door-os-backend && npm run build --prefix door-os-frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm run start --prefix door-os-backend" "npm run start --prefix door-os-frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix door-os-backend && npm install --prefix door-os-frontend
